root: ^She speaks to you, softly, with an almost melancholic tone

^<b>So... you’re here tonight… again. You failed… again. How many times has it been now? I’ve lost count. But your determination knows no limits, doesn't it? You always return, always try, but the answers always slip through your fingers. Just like her life.<b>
^She pauses, her gaze distant, before looking directly at you.

^Yes, Ashley is dead, I know it hurts to hear that... but it's not your fault, Kerlosch. You could never have known what would happen that night, especially not with her condition... sigh... It wasn’t supposed to end like this. But sometimes, even in the dark, the truth is waiting, just beyond reach.

^<b>But that doesn’t change anything now, does it? I’ve done my part. It’s time for you to choose. Would you continue this madness? This never-ending cycle of searching, of questioning, of pain… Or will you finally burn this city down and move on?<b>
^She steps back, giving you a moment to digest her words.
^I suppose I already know the answer, Kerlosch. You always do this... and I...I can't convince you otherwise.
^Then, with a defeated expression, she open her arms showing the two stands behind her.
